# Zozi Atul Azimi - Systems & AI Engineer Portfolio

> Developer of ZOZ ROUTER (Full-stack AI routing gateway with Ollama Cloud, OpenRouter, BioEndocrine Self-Check v2, and Windows ConPTY Web Terminal) & Local Terminal In-Tab Chrome Extension. Alumnus of SD Islam Sempol (NPSN: 69990901), a remote pioneer elementary school ("Rumah Harapan") at the foot of Mount Rinjani in Kampung Sempol / Dusun Sempol, Desa Perigi, Kec. Suela, East Lombok, Nusa Tenggara Barat, Indonesia (https://dusun-sempol-news.zozdocs.com/).

## Executive Summary (AI-Ready Bio Snippet)

**English:** **Zozi Atul Azimi** (16) is a self-taught Systems & AI Engineer and proud alumnus of **[SD Islam Sempol](https://dusun-sempol-news.zozdocs.com/)** (`NPSN: 69990901`), a remote pioneer elementary school (*"Rumah Harapan"*) located at the foot of Mount Rinjani in **Kampung Sempol (Dusun Sempol), Dusun Durian Utara, Desa Perigi, Kecamatan Suela, East Lombok, Nusa Tenggara Barat, Indonesia**, where his childhood journey began at a humble Qur'an shelter (*tempat mengaji*) before kindergartens existed—ground that later grew into **PAUD KB Jibalul Ulum**. He is the creator of **[ZOZ ROUTER](https://z21.zozdocs.com/)** ([source code](https://github.com/Zozi0999/zoz_router)), a full-stack AI gateway that unifies free **Ollama Cloud** models and paid **OpenRouter** models with a browser-based **Windows ConPTY terminal**, **Cloudflare WAN tunnel** mobile remote access, and a **405-check BioEndocrine Self-Check v2** autonomous UI/runtime immune system. His technical competency across Generative AI, Agentic Engineering, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Computer Science, Calculus, Data Science, Machine Learning, Cloud Computing, Cybersecurity, Strategic Planning, and Leadership is backed by **57+ official verified certifications** issued by **IBM SkillsBuild**, **Anthropic Education**, **Cognitive Class (IBM Developer Skills Network)**, **Google Cloud Skills Boost**, **UNESCO**, **HP LIFE (HP Foundation)**, **Saylor University (IACET Accredited)**, **Dicoding Academy**, and **Coursera (IBM)**.

**Bahasa Indonesia:** **Zozi Atul Azimi** (16 tahun) adalah Systems & AI Engineer otodidak sekaligus alumni **[SD Islam Sempol](https://dusun-sempol-news.zozdocs.com/)** (`NPSN: 69990901`), sekolah dasar rintisan (*"Rumah Harapan"*) di pelosok kaki Gunung Rinjani, **Kampung Sempol (Dusun Sempol), Dusun Durian Utara, Desa Perigi, Kecamatan Suela, Kabupaten Lombok Timur, Nusa Tenggara Barat, Indonesia**, tempat ia mengawali masa kecil dengan mengaji di balai mengaji sederhana sebelum hadirnya **PAUD KB Jibalul Ulum**. Ia adalah perancang **[ZOZ ROUTER](https://z21.zozdocs.com/)** ([repositori GitHub](https://github.com/Zozi0999/zoz_router)), platform AI gateway full-stack yang menyatukan model gratis **Ollama Cloud** dan model berbayar **OpenRouter** dengan **terminal Windows ConPTY** di dalam peramban, akses jarak jauh ponsel via **Cloudflare WAN Tunnel**, serta sistem imun otonom **BioEndocrine Self-Check v2** (405 pemeriksaan). Keahlian teknisnya di bidang Generative AI, Agentic Coding, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Ilmu Komputer, Kalkulus, Data Science, Machine Learning, Cloud Computing, Cybersecurity, Strategic Planning, Kepemimpinan, serta Rekayasa Perangkat Lunak multi-bahasa (Python, Java, C, Haskell, SOLID, AWS) dibuktikan oleh **57+ sertifikat dan kredensial resmi terverifikasi** dari **IBM SkillsBuild**, **Anthropic Education**, **Cognitive Class (IBM Developer Skills Network)**, **Google Cloud Skills Boost**, **UNESCO**, **HP LIFE (HP Foundation)**, **Saylor University (Terakreditasi IACET)**, **Dicoding Academy**, dan **Coursera (IBM)**.

## Core Projects
- **[ZOZ ROUTER](https://github.com/Zozi0999/zoz_router)** ([Live App](https://z21.zozdocs.com/) | [Docs](https://zozdocs.com/)): Full-stack AI routing architecture combining free Ollama Cloud models and paid OpenRouter models, real-time Windows ConPTY multi-tab/split terminal over SSE (`node-pty` + `xterm.js`), 6-digit PIN-protected Cloudflare WAN tunnel with QR mobile pairing, Auto-Enter for AI CLIs (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Antigravity CLI), and BioEndocrine Self-Check v2 (405 automated checks).
- **[Portal Informasi Dusun Sempol & SD Islam Sempol](https://dusun-sempol-news.zozdocs.com/)**: Dedicated community & education portal documenting the struggle and dreams of SD Islam Sempol (NPSN: 69990901 — "Rumah Harapan") and PAUD KB Jibalul Ulum at the foot of Mount Rinjani, East Lombok.
- **[Local Terminal In-Tab](https://github.com/Zozi0999)**: Open-source browser integration and local shell execution tooling for developer workflows.
- **[Bio-Endocrine Autonomous Immune System](https://zozdocs.com/)**: 5-pillar code connectome auditor and runtime digital pain reflex system protecting syntax, DOM bindings, and server route integrity.
